property_summary: Invariant: transferOwnership must only succeed when msg.sender == owner (or caller is owner) — the reference rejects calls when owner is zero, but the mutant incorrectly allows anyone to call transferOwnership when owner == address(0), so there exists an input (a caller address) that makes mutant succeed while reference reverts.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner to check msg.sender equals owner OR owner is zero, allowing anyone to call transferOwnership when owner is zero, altering observed transferOwnership outcome in that case.
